variables.name: control/size/sm/height
variables.description: control.size.sm — 16px box edge for a small control's own dimension: a checkbox square, a radio circle, a switch track's height (density: comfortable). A SQUARE control reads this on both axes.

variables.name: control/size/sm/width
variables.description: control.size.sm width — 32px track width for a two-position control, i.e. a switch (2x the 16px height, the field-convergent track ratio). A square control uses `height` on both axes and does not read this.
